# The alley's walls: the back wall (face at world Z -1.52, 9.2 x 5.6 m) and the side walls (faces at
# X -4.6 and 4.6, Z -1.52..9.5, 4.6 m tall), only their court-side faces kept, textured with drawn
# bricks and murals (0.12 m a texel); copings; the hoop's sliding rail; a lamp over the door and one
# on the right wall (unlit in the bake). Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Back --base-color 1 1 1 --no-slot
material new Left --base-color 1 1 1 --no-slot
material new Right --base-color 1 1 1 --no-slot
material new Coping --base-color 0.1608 0.1529 0.1961 --no-slot
material new Rail --base-color 0.3255 0.3451 0.4039 --no-slot
material new Lamp --base-color 0.9255 0.8353 0.4275 --no-slot
material new LampBox --base-color 0.1608 0.1529 0.1961 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name BackWall --size 1 --location 0.0000 1.5700 2.8000
scale 9.2000 0.1000 5.6000
apply --scale
material assign Back
select BackWall
active BackWall
mode edit
select face where "!(normal.y < -0.9)"
delete face
mode object
select BackWall
active BackWall
mode edit
select all
uv project-from-view front --scale-to-bounds
mode object
add mesh cube --name LeftWall --size 1 --location -4.6500 -3.9900 2.3000
scale 0.1000 11.0200 4.6000
apply --scale
material assign Left
select LeftWall
active LeftWall
mode edit
select face where "!(normal.x > 0.9)"
delete face
mode object
select LeftWall
active LeftWall
mode edit
select all
uv project-from-view right --scale-to-bounds
mode object
add mesh cube --name RightWall --size 1 --location 4.6500 -3.9900 2.3000
scale 0.1000 11.0200 4.6000
apply --scale
material assign Right
select RightWall
active RightWall
mode edit
select face where "!(normal.x < -0.9)"
delete face
mode object
select RightWall
active RightWall
mode edit
select all
uv project-from-view left --scale-to-bounds
mode object
add mesh cube --name CapBack --size 1 --location 0.0000 1.5300 5.6800
scale 9.4000 0.2600 0.1600
apply --scale
material assign Coping
select CapBack
active CapBack
mode edit
select face where "!(normal.y < -0.9 || normal.z < -0.9)"
delete face
mode object
add mesh cube --name CapLeft --size 1 --location -4.5900 -3.9900 4.6800
scale 0.2200 11.0200 0.1600
apply --scale
material assign Coping
select CapLeft
active CapLeft
mode edit
select face where "!(normal.x > 0.9 || normal.z < -0.9)"
delete face
mode object
add mesh cube --name CapRight --size 1 --location 4.5900 -3.9900 4.6800
scale 0.2200 11.0200 0.1600
apply --scale
material assign Coping
select CapRight
active CapRight
mode edit
select face where "!(normal.x < -0.9 || normal.z < -0.9)"
delete face
mode object
add mesh cube --name Rail --size 1 --location 0.0000 1.4600 3.4000
scale 5.2000 0.1200 0.2600
apply --scale
material assign Rail
select Rail
active Rail
mode edit
select face where "!(normal.y > -0.9)"
delete face
mode object
add mesh cube --name LampLBox --size 1 --location -4.4900 -4.8500 3.0900
scale 0.2200 0.4400 0.1800
apply --scale
material assign LampBox
add mesh cube --name LampL --size 1 --location -4.4500 -4.8500 2.9500
scale 0.2200 0.3600 0.1000
apply --scale
material assign Lamp
add mesh cube --name LampRBox --size 1 --location 4.4900 -2.6000 3.0900
scale 0.2200 0.4400 0.1800
apply --scale
material assign LampBox
add mesh cube --name LampR --size 1 --location 4.4500 -2.6000 2.9500
scale 0.2200 0.3600 0.1000
apply --scale
material assign Lamp
material texture Back base-color textures/back.png
material texture Left base-color textures/left.png
material texture Right base-color textures/right.png
select all
shade flat
export walls.glb
